, Kenosha County, and surrounding areas who are looking for natural ways to support muscle tension relief, mobility, and recovery.
Sciatica is a term used to describe irritation or compression involving the
— the largest nerve in the body. The sciatic nerve travels from the lower back through the hips and glutes and down each leg.
- Pain radiating down the buttock or leg
- Muscle tightness in the hips or glutes
